name: Harvey
bestFor: The category-leading AI platform for law firms and in-house legal teams doing document-heavy legal work
description: A legal AI platform built with and for law firms, handling contract analysis, research, drafting, and due diligence at the level of accuracy large firms require, deeply integrated into legal workflows.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; enterprise sales process only

paidTier.notes: No published pricing. Industry-reported figures: roughly $1,000–$2,000/user/month for mid-market firms, dropping to $100–$200/user/month at Am Law 100 scale with volume discounts; 25–50 seat minimums; median annual contract reported around $175,000 — not official figures.

name: Ironclad (Jurist AI)
bestFor: AI-assisted contract lifecycle management — drafting, redlining, and analyzing contracts at scale
description: A contract lifecycle management platform whose Jurist AI Assist and AI Contract Analysis modules draft, review, and extract obligations from contracts, integrated into approval workflows.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; demo-and-quote sales process

paidTier.notes: No published pricing. Reported figures: base platform roughly $30,000–$250,000+/year (mid-market commonly $50K–$120K); the Jurist AI Assist add-on is separately reported at $50,000–$200,000/year — not official figures.

name: Spellbook
bestFor: AI contract drafting and redlining that works inside Microsoft Word, for smaller legal teams
description: An AI contract-drafting copilot that runs as a Word add-in, suggesting redlines, flagging risky clauses, and drafting new provisions in the tool lawyers already draft in.

freeTier.limits: 7-day free trial; no persistent free tier

paidTier.notes: No published price list — quoted per seat. Industry-reported figures: Associate-level plans around $89/user/month, rising through Pro, to Enterprise reported around $350/user/month with a 6-month minimum commitment — not official figures.
